What Bounty Pro includes

Pro provides advanced insights, creation or changes to recurring expense rules, and optional receipt text scanning on supported Android devices. Cloud sharing is paused and is not a paid benefit.

Groups, exact and unequal splits, currency-separated ledgers, recorded settlements, manual receipt itemization, attachments and exports remain free. Existing records and recurring rules remain accessible after Pro ends. Demo previews do not create a subscription or grant Pro in another workspace.

Price, billing period and renewal

Choose an available monthly or yearly Google Play plan. Bounty displays the actual localized price and period returned by the store. Checkout is authoritative for the amount, currency, taxes and any offer. The yearly price is charged for the full year, not in monthly instalments. No free trial is advertised.

Google Play charges payment when you confirm the purchase. A plan automatically renews for its displayed period unless renewal is cancelled through Google Play before the applicable deadline.

Use Manage subscriptions in Bounty or Google Play subscription settings to view renewal details and cancel. Cancellation ordinarily stops a future renewal; access and refunds follow Google Play and applicable rights. For a monthly/yearly change, use the available plan-change control and review the replacement amount and renewal date in checkout rather than buying a second subscription.

Sign-in, restore and changing devices

Sign in to the Bounty account that should hold Pro before a purchase or restore. Bounty associates subscription status with the Firebase user identifier. The current RevenueCat transfer setting means restoring or purchasing with the same Google Play account can move Pro from another Bounty account to the account being used. RevenueCat updates access for the previous account; expense records remain separate and are not merged.

On another Android device, use the same intended Bounty identity and the Google Play account used for the purchase, then choose Restore purchases. Account linking and cross-platform purchase continuity are not offered. Paid Apple and web products are unavailable.

A cancelled checkout grants no new access. If the provider reports a pending payment, Bounty waits for confirmation. If plans are unavailable, retry later or contact support. Bounty does not invent a price or active subscription. Subscription commands require a current sign-in check; when that check cannot reach the service, saved Local records remain available and subscription access may need a retry.

Deletion and billing help

Deleting app data, deleting a Bounty account, signing out or uninstalling does not cancel a Google Play subscription. Manage renewal separately with Google Play. You may keep a purchase reference for support; never send full card details or a store password.

Use Google Play for its cancellation and refund controls, and contact kunal26das@gmail.com if Bounty access is incorrect. A support email does not itself change billing. Account and data deletion explains how verified account requests are handled.
